text:
noelle: Quick thread to capture the tiny checklist for the docs migration. Focus areas: naming consistency, code-snippet casing, and glossary redirects. I'll batch fixes so reviewers can do small, fast PRs.

marc: Sounds good. For naming: propose we standardize on 'model_variant' (snake case) in YAML/configs and 'modelVariant' in JS examples. Keep 'model_id' as the canonical persistent identifier field across all examples.

ilya: Agreed. Also recommend we add a short note in the style guide about disambiguating 'variant' vs 'replica' — say: "Variant = user-facing model selection; Replica = runtime copy (internal)."

noelle: Will add that line. Also found several examples in migrate/ that still use the old embeddings path. I'll replace those links with the batch embeddings page and leave a redirect note.

noelle: Old: /migrate/old-embeds -> New: /migrate/embeddings-batch (I'll include both in the PR)

docs-bot: lint: docs warning in examples/curl.md: parameter name mismatch detected (model vs model_id) at line 14

marc: I'll take the curl examples and update them to JSON body with model_id and include an alias mapping snippet. Example suggestion: `{"model_id":"gpt-3","input":"Hello","alias":"stable-latest"}`

ilya: I'll run a repo grep for modelVariantId, model_variant_id, modelId, model_id and open tiny PRs for each group. Tagging the PRs so reviewers can batch.

noelle: Plan: PRs -> #481 (style-guide entries), #482 (examples casing fix), #483 (curl/migrate link fixes), #484 (glossary disambiguation). Canary merge Thursday morning if all green.

marc: For the glossary entry, please add an example sentence: "Users should say 'select a model variant' in tutorials; operations teams may refer to 'replicas' when discussing runtime scaling."

ilya: Also add a doc note about casing in SDK snippets: show native casing for each language with small callouts, e.g., Python: `model_id`, JS: `modelVariantId`, YAML/configs: `model_variant_id`.

noelle: Great. If anyone takes a PR, drop a short note here so we avoid overlap. I'll do final pass on links after merges.

docs-bot: CI: preview site updated for branch 482: https://preview.docs.redwood/branches/482 (success)

marc: Taking #483 for link fixes.

ilya: Taking #482 for snippet casing.

noelle: Thanks everyone. Small edits, quick reviews — aim to finish by Wednesday EOD. Ping here with PR numbers. :seedling:
